records.subject: A few days into Wrenfield -- how's it going?
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Quick note to see how things are going. A lot of teams get stuck at the same step -- inviting teammates -- so if that's where you are, happy to walk through it.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Maple Analytics set up
records.body:
Hi Rosa,

Your Wrenfield account is live. A simple way to start: one project, a handful of real tasks, then an invite to a teammate. No need to overthink the setup.

Here if you need anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Maple Analytics* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to two emails (email:93f1f160, email:ba1918e4) despite a held onboarding call (calendar:b039b163). Engagement signal is a completed call, but no product action since; 8 days left makes unaided activation possible but unlikely.

draft.subject: Picking up where our call left off
draft.body:
Hi Rosa,

Thanks again for making time for the getting started call last week. I know the first week gets busy, so I wanted to check in.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually the quickest way to see whether it fits how Maple Analytics works. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to work through that first project with you live, or answer anything by email if that's easier.

Best,
Chidi
